_why: Architecture plan step 0 (2026-09-30): the surface may shrink but not grow without a deliberate edit here. 64 hosted tools, 68 cxp commands and 36 tables carried the usage in which ~a quarter to a third did 90% of the work. Raising a number is a decision: say why in the commit.
_raised: 2026-09-30: cxp_commands 68→69 for `cxp health` (step 3, daily health line); mc2_tables 36→37 for `webhook_runs` (step 3, a run record on every webhook path).

2026-10-01: hosted_tools 64→71 for step 5b — the stdio server (17 tools) was retired and the seven verbs only it carried (fetch_project_source, compare_project_sources, pull_document_comments, push_to_dropbox, preflight, list_vendors, list_rfp_respondents) moved to hosted. Net MCP surface across both servers fell 81→71; cxp_commands fell 69→68 (`cxp mcp`) without a ceiling change.
_lowered: 2026-10-01: step 5 retire list — hosted_tools 71→55 (16 zero-use/dormant tools retired: worksets, notes, step editors, etc.), cxp_commands 69→53 (11 dead commands, dates-loop, weekly-sort, snapshots, mcp), mc2_tables 37→34 (notes, worksets, spine_snapshots out of the registry). Frozen at these counts until 2026-11-01 (Drew): no raise without a reason in the commit.
